name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2026-05-20, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
